name: Formoterol
summary: Fast-onset, 12-hour beta-2 agonist that enables maintenance-and-reliever (SMART) therapy when combined with budesonide.
mechanism: Full agonist at beta-2 adrenergic receptors — rapid relaxation of airway smooth muscle lasting ~12 h.

dosing.adult: 12 mcg twice daily (DPI); 9 mcg, 2 puffs twice daily (MDI); 12 mcg 15 min before exercise for EIB

safety.pregnancy: Inhaled — minimal systemic exposure; maintaining asthma control is the priority
contraindications: Hypersensitivity to formoterol or lactose (DPI formulation)
warnings: Never use as monotherapy in asthma (class boxed warning)
safety.overdose: Beta-agonist excess: tremor, tachycardia, hypokalemia, arrhythmias — supportive care with ECG and potassium monitoring

indications: Asthma maintenance (with an ICS; SMART regimen with budesonide)
clinicalPearls: Fastest-onset LABA — the reason budesonide/formoterol can serve as both maintenance and reliever
Onset approaches that of salbutamol, but duration is 12 h
good: Rapid relief plus long duration — ideal for maintenance-and-reliever regimens
bad: Monotherapy in asthma; using it as a frequent rescue beyond the maintenance dose
